goals: Normalize selected executable-gate fixture, numerical-solver fidelity and tolerance provenance into the existing test-register build path.
Separate physical fixture realism from numerical-solver fidelity.
Fail closed when convergence, solver-cost or performance-tail claims are attached to a numerically inert solver fixture.
Retain zero-step and synthetic stubs for interface, state-isolation, binding and deterministic-replay claims where those claims do not depend on nonlinear state updates.
Preserve F-TA02 advisory owner/dependency impact-selection semantics and qualification boundaries.
claim_boundary: F-TA03 validates whether a gate is architecturally capable of supporting a stated claim class. It does not establish scientific validity, numerical accuracy, mass closure or production qualification by itself.

triggering_finding.finding: The F-PE03/F-SI18 binary convergence-cost cliff was generated by a zero-correction TRIDAG test stub. A test-only SWAP 4.3.1 Thomas/TRIDAG control removed the cliff and exposed accepted higher-cost routes.
